sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops Firebase Analytics from collecting usage data and the Google Mobile Ads SDK from starting at launch.
Hides full-screen ads and the Remove ads button in the side menu.
Unlocks Pro features, including PDF annotations and form filling, WebDAV and FTP sync, text-to-speech controls and extra toolbar and shelf options.

sources.label: A collection of unofficial Android patches built with the Morphe framework
sources.author: Binarymend
patch_list: Changes the app title to 'Moon+ Reader Pro' and removes the 'Remove Ads' button from the drawer.
Unlocks Pro features including PDF support, ad-free experience, and more.
